categories.main_business_segments: Shenzhen Tongyi Industry Co., Ltd. operates primarily in three segments: high-end chemical and electronic materials agency and solution services, self-branded production of composite material plates and rods, and industrial internet platform services (Tongyi Cloud Commerce). The company provides integrated solutions including R&D, production, sales, and supply chain services for engineering plastics and electronic materials used in consumer electronics, smart appliances, automotive, new energy, 5G, chips, and display panels.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced polymer materials technology including engineering plastics such as PEEK, PEI, PPS, PA6, PA66, ABS, PC, POM, HDPE, and PP. It has developed extrusion molding for special engineering plastics and composite materials, with in-house capabilities in material formulation, equipment and mold design, and process optimization. The company also operates a high-level R&D center and a provincial academician workstation focusing on polymer extrusion and foaming technologies, supporting product innovation and quality improvement.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading brands and OEMs in mobile phones and consumer electronics (Huawei, Honor, VIVO, OPPO, Xiaomi), automotive (BYD, Geely), smart appliances, new energy, 5G, semiconductor, and display panel industries. The company serves over 10 industries, 100 well-known brands, 1,000 large processing enterprises, and 10,000 quality SMEs, focusing on providing value-added material solutions and technical services.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with significant sales in South China, East China, other mainland regions, Hong Kong, and overseas markets. It has production bases in Jiangxi Xinfeng and Jiangsu Dongtai, and subsidiaries in Hong Kong, Vietnam, and the United States. The company is expanding marketing centers and offices in Shenzhen, Suzhou, and other regions to cover South and East China and overseas markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shenzhen Tongyi Industry Co., Ltd. operates primarily as a midstream and downstream integrated solutions provider in the supply chain. It acts as an agent and solution provider for raw materials, a manufacturer of composite engineering plastic products, and an operator of an industrial internet platform facilitating digitalized supply chain services. The company integrates upstream raw material suppliers and downstream brand customers, providing technical support, inventory management, and flexible supply chain services.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company focuses on innovation in high-performance polymer materials, composite plates and rods, and digital transformation of the materials supply chain. It emphasizes R&D in special engineering plastics, lightweight and functional materials, and import substitution. The company invests in expanding production capacity, enhancing product quality, and building a high-level R&D center and academician workstation to foster technology breakthroughs and market competitiveness.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of high-end chemical and electronic materials, composite engineering plastics, and related components. The company also earns income from technical service solutions, supply chain management, and digital platform services via its industrial internet platform. Sales channels include offline distribution and online sales, with a majority of revenue from offline sales.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company positions itself as a leading domestic integrated solution provider in high-end chemical and electronic materials with nearly 20 years of industry experience. It competes with foreign and domestic suppliers in the engineering plastics and electronic materials markets, leveraging its technical service capabilities, flexible supply chain, and strong customer relationships. The company benefits from the growing trend of domestic substitution and the rise of Chinese brands in strategic emerging industries.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 3.07 billion, a 5.57% decrease from the previous year, and a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 95.5 million. The self-branded production segment grew by 61.32% in revenue, while the agency segment faced pressure due to intensified competition. The company has total assets of about RMB 2.18 billion and equity attributable to shareholders of RMB 957 million. It is undergoing capacity expansion and digital transformation to support future growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its comprehensive technical service capabilities, including R&D support, mold design, process optimization, and supply chain flexibility, to reduce customer costs and improve product quality. It offers a broad product portfolio of high-performance engineering plastics and composite materials tailored to customer needs. Its integrated 'agency + self-brand + industrial internet platform' business model creates a differentiated competitive advantage by combining upstream and downstream resources and enabling rapid market response.
